resources.string:
"
Important Notice (Minecraft 1.26.50+ / NetherNet):
Minecraft Bedrock recently replaced RakNet LAN discovery with encrypted NetherNet (UDP 7551) and HTTP Signaling (TCP 19132) requiring cryptographic Xbox identity binding (a=identity). Because LAN connections do not include this token, joining external servers via Fake-LAN on consoles without a full Microsoft Auth proxy is no longer supported by Minecraft.

Direct connections via the 'Servers' tab (entering your phone's IP and port 19132) work at full speed via TCP & UDP!

---

The app connects to a BedrockConnect server by default.

These servers are not part of our project but are operated by another community (https://github.com/Pugmatt/BedrockConnect) and they have nothing to do with the app, except for granting permission to use the servers.

Direct connection:
Enter your IP and port, then press Confirm to change the server.
After that, you can save the server to the list by clicking on the plus symbol.
Long press on an entry deletes it from the list.

To enable the app to work in the background, you may need to adjust the app's power-saving options in the Android settings.
"
